notes:
Summary: evaluation stalled — strong product fit for internal knowledge search + assistant but economics don't pencil at scale. Customer saw conservative ROI; token costs + dedicated commit size are main objections.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-18: inbound trial sign-up; initial discovery with Samira (AE).
- 2025-12-03: arch deep-dive with Diego (SE). Discussed VPC, SSO, retention.
- 2026-01-12: 1st POC kickoff call; set target: reduce average latency < 200ms for short queries, 50 qps baseline. Finance wants ARR < $150k for pilot-to-prod.
- 2026-02-03: cost model review. We ran token cost simulation on 2M monthly queries; showed hosted costs ~$18k/mo vs OpenAI proposal ~$12k/mo (discounted).
- 2026-02-18: security questionnaire submitted by customer; outstanding items around KMS flow and audit log retention (asked for HSM details).
- 2026-02-24: internal pause — CFO flagged commit size and prefers vendor with bundled credits/discount. Customer evaluating Anthropic offer with 30% off and committed credits.

Key quotes / verbatims:
- "We love the routing and cache plan — but the math needs to be tighter." — Director, Search Product
- "If we have to commit >3 GPUs we're not getting approval this quarter." — Finance lead

Technical notes / requirements:
- Workloads: short-search queries (avg tokens in/out 40), and chat assistant sessions (avg 220 tokens/session).
- Latency target: 150-250ms p95 for search; 400ms p95 for chat acceptable with batching.
- Throughput: expected 40-80 qps search during peak; burst up to 200 qps.
- Model preferences: open Llama-2 variants for on-prem/dedicated; permissive to Redwood curated open models.
- Routing: want fallback to cheaper quantized variant when load high.

Why stalled / loss risk details:
- Unit economics: their projected token volume amplifies per-token hosted costs; finance insists on guaranteed unit price or large commit to swing approvals.
- Commit size: minimum Dedicated reservation presented exceeds what their procurement will sign this quarter.
- Competitor pressure: Anthropic offered credit stack + introductory pricing that undercuts our hosted list rate for first 6 months.
- Internal champion: Product champion (Sr PM) is strong, but engineering lead shifted priorities to vector infra re-architecture — reduced bandwidth for POC.

Suggested mitigation / recommended next steps:
- Offer a narrow POC scope: limit to search pipeline only, enforce token caps, instrument cost dashboards daily.
- Provide a targeted econ proposal: blended unit rate for first 3 months tied to commit and cache hit targets; include an explicit fallback plan (quantized model) to show marginal cost reductions.
- Fast-track security appendix: send HSM/KMS diagram and SOC2 audit excerpt; assign a security SME to the questionnaire.
- Seek micro-commit: 3-month reserved burst (1-2 GPUs equivalent) vs the large annual commit they fear.

Internal notes / AE playbook:
- Diego to prepare detailed token simulation by 2026-03-12 (done) — include caching scenarios that reduce token spend by 35-50%.
- Samira to push finance intro and loop in CRO for commercial flexibility if customer shows clear path to $150k ARR.
- Watch competitor credits timeline; if Anthropic's credits expire, re-open cadence.

Stance: At risk (economics). Re-engage after finance Q-cycle or when Anthropic promo ends.
